name: Saikyou no Onna Reika to Ryou -Koujoku Kuppuku no Kiroku-
original_name: 最強の女・麗華と涼 －肛辱屈服の記録－
source:
The main character is an ordinary school boy.
One day, he was tangled with a group of yakuza in a forest of neon.
He thought he managed to escape, but he was found by one of these men in a park.
He thought it would be end of his life, then Reika, who was during the course of training, came to save him.
Eventually Ryo appeared and they started chatting in a cheerful way.
The main character was in a daze, and when he came back to earth, they were already surrounded by several men.

translation:
主人公是一名普通男学生。
一天，他在霓虹闪烁的街头被一群黑道分子纠缠。
他本以为自己成功逃脱，却在公园里被其中一人找到。
他以为自己就要命丧于此，这时正在训练途中的丽华现身救下了他。
随后，凉也出现了，众人开始愉快地交谈。
主人公一时出了神，等回过神来时，他们已经被几名男子团团包围。
